name: VitaGreen Nutritious Meal
summary: A nutritious meal made from **12 seeds and grains** (soy-free) combined with **Okinawa Mozuku Fucoidan, 95% Curcumin, Spirulina, Pea Protein** and FOS fiber. Sweetened with stevia, no refined sugar – easy to mix, easy to drink, and handy for busy people.
highlights: Sweetened with stevia, no refined sugar
Made to GMP and ISO 22000:2018 standards

sections.title: Ingredients
sections.text:
**Grains & seeds:** Oats, Brown rice, Green peas, Chickpeas, Black beans, White beans, Macadamia nuts, Walnuts, Almonds, Black sesame, Lotus seeds, Cocoa.

**Key ingredients:** 95% Curcumin, Spirulina (blue-green algae), Fucoidan extracted from Okinawa Mozuku brown seaweed, Red dates (jujube), Goji berries, Pea Protein (plant protein), FOS (soluble fiber), stevia, Vitamin B1.

sections.title: Highlights
items: **12 seeds and grains:** the base of a balanced meal – good carbs, healthy fats, plant protein, plus natural vitamins and minerals.
**Okinawa Mozuku Fucoidan:** a Japanese brown seaweed extract that helps support immune health and provides antioxidants.
**95% Curcumin:** extracted from Vietnamese turmeric; provides antioxidants and helps support digestive balance.
**Spirulina:** a micro-algae rich in plant protein, vitamins and minerals.
**Pea Protein:** high-quality plant protein that is gentle on digestion.
**FOS:** soluble fiber that supports digestion and a healthy gut microbiome.
**Stevia:** no refined sugar, suitable for people who need to limit sugar.

sections.title: Benefits
sections.text: Provides nutrition from grains and seeds; adds vitamins, minerals, plant protein and fiber; supports healthy digestion; helps support overall health and resilience. Can be used as a snack meal or to complement your daily meals.

sections.title: Who it's for
sections.text: Children aged 3 and up; adults who want extra nutrition; older adults with a small appetite; vegetarians and vegans; busy people; anyone who wants more plant protein and fiber.

sections.title: How to use
sections.text:
**Quick mix:** stir 25–30g (3 level scoops) into 150–180ml of water at about 60°C and drink right away. 2–3 times a day.

**Standard mix:** stir 25–30g into 100ml of cool water, let it soak for a moment, then add about 100ml of hot water at 70°C.

**Smoothie:** blend 100ml of cool water + 1 sachet (25g) + fruit of your choice (add milk or ice if you like).

sections.title: Storage
items: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
Shelf life: 24 months from the manufacturing date.

sections.title: Standards & lab testing

Made at the factory of Vitanuts Green Nutrition JSC under GMP standards and an ISO 22000:2018 system, manufacturer's standard TCCS/012/VITANUTS/2025. Tested at the National Institute for Food Control (NIFC): physicochemical, microbiological, heavy metal and Aflatoxin M1 indicators all meet requirements.

disclaimer: Dietary supplement. This product is not a medicine and does not replace medical treatment.
